test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
If the given sheet is folded to form a cube, which among the given figures is possible?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47d64dda6b82dbae841953b24c515b44754faf126a2db4a5752645f38d50ac41.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f20400d583b94b794fe7c094521d481f0ab953977e3a8e1d9a2b3630ea9d5391.png] 

4 and 1 are the opposite sides.

6 and 3 are the opposite sides.

5 and 2 are the opposite sides.

And, two opposite sides can not be adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shown in a dice.

Now,

Option 1): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a026394bfda836a2a0d213c62f5f1d5154a2d27adb14c02b4db271c7d86cde5.png] → Can not be made, because 1 and 4 are the opposite sides,

Option 2): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4a70794e50062228058a2439c2a97928a505450ddcca52008226642503f5520.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides,

 

Option 3): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/203d0d14c39dd422a82be1b3c48c36cc1b01c0151cbec1282f816517130a6450.png] → Can not be made, because 2 and 5 are the opposite sides,

Option 4): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d97571610549245faeca5257973397183116532ffc91ce6c565b9af3cc36a685.png] → Can not be made, because 6 and 3 are the opposite sides,

So, Figure in option (2) can be possible.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (2)".**
